# Example Co — filled slots

Example Co is a fictional meal-kit subscription company used to test this pack
with every slot filled. Each file is what a consumer would place in its overlay as
`.agents/skills/example-co-<slot>/SKILL.md`. Nothing here describes a real
organisation.

| File | Slot |
|---|---|

| [prd-bar.md](prd-bar.md) | `prd-bar` |
| [review-lenses.md](review-lenses.md) | `review-lenses` |
| [planning-conventions.md](planning-conventions.md) | `planning-conventions` |
| [tracker-fields.md](tracker-fields.md) | `tracker-fields` |
